newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices hold steady with stable natgas.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices hold steady with stable natgas.

text.p: Wholesale power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held steady again Thursday amid slightly below-normal temperatures in the region and stable spot natural gas prices, market sources said.
Prices for peak, firm power for Friday delivery were stable in the $25.00-26.50 range, sources said, with offers as high as $27.50.
Off-peak ERCOT power for Friday delivery was also unchanged in the $13.00-15.00 area, traders said.
December peak power was talked steady at $24.25-24.75, while January/February ERCOT power prices hovered in the $24.50-25.50 range, sources said.
Temperatures are expected to remain cooler-than-normal in eastern Texas through the weekend but edge up to about three degrees above-normal in western Texas on Saturday.
Spot natural gas prices were flat today in the low-$2.60s per million British thermal units.
